description: Rebuild deck.html and review.md from a review.json that was edited by hand, with the current brand settings. Returns the path of the deck. No model call, no cost. Use it after changing review.json instead of generating again.

directory.description: The project folder: a git repository, with or without sprint-review.config.yml. Default: the folder the server started in.

file.description: Path to the review.json to render, e.g. sprint-reviews/2026-11-22/review.json.

name: render_sprint_review
title: Rebuild an edited deck
